description: Test cases for competitor research skill — validates web scraping, field extraction, entity resolution, and merge logic

evals.prompt: Perform deep research on Terra AI (website: terraai.com). Scrape the website, LinkedIn company page, and news search for any mentions in the past 30 days. Extract the following fields: founders (names + titles), team size, latest funding round (type, amount, date, investors), core products, pricing model, and any hiring signals. Return structured JSON with all extracted fields, confidence scores for each, and source URLs.
evals.expected_output: JSON with extracted fields for Terra AI including founders array, team_size with confidence, latest_round details, products list, and hiring_signals array

evals.prompt: Given 5 companies (Terra AI, GeologicAI, Fleet Space, Stratum AI, Mineral Forecast), perform research on each. For each company, extract current team size from both the company website and LinkedIn profile. Compare the values: if they match exactly (confidence >= 0.95), mark as 'auto_merged'. If they differ by less than 10% (confidence 0.85-0.95), note the discrepancy and use decision logic (prefer website if both are recent, prefer LinkedIn if website is stale). Return JSON showing all team_size extractions with merge decisions applied.
evals.expected_output: JSON with merged_companies array showing team_size field with 'auto_merged' or 'decision_merged' status, including old_value, new_value, sources, and confidence scores

evals.prompt: Search for recent news, press releases, and job postings for GeologicAI, VerAI, and Fleet Space (focus on last 60 days). For each company, extract events of the following types: funding_round, leadership_change, product_launch, partnership, hiring_surge. For each event, record: date, description, source URL, and confidence score. Return JSON organized by company with events array showing a chronological timeline.
evals.expected_output: JSON with events array grouped by company, each event showing event_type, date, description, source_urls array, and confidence score. Total of 5-10 events across the 3 companies.
